name: san_juan

known_heights_m._note: Published height from The Skyscraper Center (CTBUH), skyscrapercenter.com/building/cosmopolitan/18713 (read 2026-10-08: 65 m, 19 floors, 2010, 555 Monserrate Street); position = the polygon centroid of the OSM footprint named 'Cosmopolitan' (tagged 3.7 m in OSM). CTBUH's public San Juan list has only two buildings (Coliseum Tower Residences 78.9 m is in Hato Rey, south of the bbox); Wikipedia has no San Juan/Puerto Rico list. OSM tags top out at 86 m here: San Juan is a 60-90 m mid-rise beach front, no tower reaches 100 m.

_bbox_note: Old San Juan islet (El Morro to the Capitol), Miramar/Condado and the Condado lagoon, Ocean Park, Punta Las Marias and Isla Verde up to the airport fence (-65.996). Hato Rey's Milla de Oro (18.42 N) is outside.
_satellite_note: 2026-10-08 (Esri identify, free): World Imagery = Vantor 2025 satellite, per area: WV03 2025-06-06 0.31 m (Old San Juan), WV02 2025-08-31 0.5 m (Condado), LG04 2025-06-06 0.34 m (Isla Verde): satellite, so towers lean (off-nadir not measured); Wayback holds >= 9 scenes: 2010 aerial, WV03 2015-11 (WV02 2016-01 in Old San Juan), WV02 2017-05-12, WV03 2018-01-04, WV03 2019-01-15, WV02 2021-01-16, GE01 2022-11-08, WV02 2024-01-30, 2025.
_pending_note: 2026-10-08: drone Photo Spheres confirmed by a one-image screen (free metadata scan of 5916 points within 2 km of the 28 OSM towers >= 60 m, 698 user spheres; 20 screened; OSM roads did not load, so the road-distance score term is flat). Ramed Vigil 2025-08, high over the Condado lagoon 374 m from the Condado towers; Ariel Bermudez Ortiz 2018-01, over the lagoon 450 m, Condado/Miramar row in view. Not captured: a 2-row hi-res sphere (15 headings x pitches 8/-18 = 30 images, free allowance, ~$0.21 at list price) each needs approval. Other high scorers are ground level, piers or cruise-ship decks; none confirmed at Isla Verde or Old San Juan.
_truth_note: Survey-only truth, single source (2026-10-08): no Google 3D Tiles cross-check (monthly cap). Read from USGS_LPC_PR_PRVI_E_2018 (GPS-dated 2018-05-14, after Hurricane Maria), the newest of four PR EPT projects here. The repo reads it since 6653856 (fix in lidar_3dep._is_in_us; the scratch run had patched covers()). Truth keyed on the report ring since 2026-10-09 (benchmark.report_key); tiles read: see runs/benchmark/truth/san_juan.json. 916 footprints in runs/benchmark/truth/san_juan.json (the 6 tallest of 99 strip tiles: Condado, Miramar, the Condado lagoon); max 85.9 m, none >= 100 m. Published vs survey: Cosmopolitan 65.7 m (published 65.0).
